statement._text: NoLoc -Hah!  Success!  You delayed the demolition long enough that Desy was able to get an official letter from the headmaster through!  I have both the time and the authority to go examine that Rune Wall!
NoLoc -Excellent work, [PlayerName]. You’ve earned your reward. Now, I have runes to memorize!

NoLoc - Good job out the-...Wait, you did everything on the list?  Didn't I say not to go overboard?  Well, let's just hope that doesn’t have unintended consequences. We actually do need that tunnel blocked before the Scourge use it...
NoLoc - It feels like you did little bit of overkill, but better safe than sorry.  Excellent work, [PlayerName]
NoLoc -Word just came in. They’ve gone and demolished the tunnel....
NoLoc -*sigh* I guess we’ll just have to make do without that critical rune. You did put your life on the line, so I can’t in good conscience deny you your reward...But damn if this doesn’t sting.
NoLoc -You didn't even get ONE task done?!
NoLoc - Ah!  Your arrival is most opportune.  We have a serious problem, Initiate.

NoLoc - So, have you heard about how the old golem production facility started up again, after that rogue golem made its proclamation just outside?  Well, some people have started finding ways inside.

NoLoc - An adventurer found a rune wall down in a mine shaft in there...From his description, I think one of those runes might be exactly what I need in order to crack the Immaculate’s spell wide open.

NoLoc - The problem is, there’s plenty of Scourge that have managed to infiltrate the place as well.  The engineering branch just decided that it was highly likely that this tunnel could be used bypass the walls and invade the city.
NoLoc - And guess who just got the contract to not just guard the tunnel but also collapse it with explosives?
NoLoc - Victor and the Wolfgang Mercenaries, I assume.

NoLoc - Exactly.  Now, he could just as easily collapse the tunnel deeper in and let us keep our access to the rune wall, or at least allow me to examine it first.  But given our recent...Antagonism...He’s taking more drastic action.

NoLoc - He’s going to collapse the tunnel beyond, in front of, and directly on top of the Rune Wall, permanently blocking all access. And he’s ordered his Wolfgang friends to keep the area clear of any interference, with lethal force if they have to.
NoLoc - What? Why’s he going so over the top with this?
NoLoc - Somehow, I’m not surprised it’s coming to this.

NoLoc - Well, first of all, I think it’s personal at this point.  He’s a man who hates to lose control.  And not only did you leave his service, you immediately acted against him behind his back. The rumor mill is churning over this and he's losing face.

NoLoc - I suspect his urge right now is to do whatever it takes to solidify his position, and make his opposition, that’s you and me, look as weak as possible right now. Regardless of if it destroys priceless history or ancient knowledge in the process.

NoLoc - Secondly...I suspect he knows what we’re working on.  Having the Scourge hordes become less of a threat means less work for him, and less contracts for the mercs he’s so buddy-buddy with.  They all stand to lose business if we succeed.
NoLoc - So he's going to deliberately stop us from fixing the Scourge, by any means, huh?

NoLoc - Precisely.  Now, the only one who can officially delay the demolition and get the Wolfgang to stand aside for me is the headmaster.  And he’s been summoned to Berg to be questioned by the Blue Chamber over a recent incident there.

NoLoc - The demolition is scheduled to take place in about 20 days. The headmaster is unlikely to get back before then, and no one from Sorobor is even allowed to see him at the moment. So, unless that demolition suffers some mysterious setbacks...
NoLoc - Can't I just write down the runes and show them to you?
NoLoc - You’re asking me to commit sabotage.
NoLoc - Oh really.  How familiar are you with Rune Magic, Initiate?
NoLoc - Uh...Not at all, actually.
NoLoc - Right, so...Why are you even offering?  Rune Magic doesn’t work like that.

NoLoc - Runes have a multitude of contexts depending on positioning, proximity, ordering and inflection. It's like a magical language where each letter’s meaning can change drastically. Each rune also has a magical signature that can't be passed on with just sketches.

NoLoc - If I have just a sketch, which I already do, I can hazard a guess at how to compel the rune, but I'm still just shooting fireballs in the dark. I might succeed, or I might trigger some completely unintended and unhelpful effect.
NoLoc - I would much rather avoid any unpleasant surprises, thank you. Do not “wing it”, as you humans call it, unless you absolutely must.
NoLoc - I've got an especially good eidetic memory, I just need 15 minutes in front of that wall and I'll know everything I need to know.  But if I don't get that delay...
NoLoc - How essential is this one rune?
NoLoc - It’s important enough that I'm asking you to perform sabotage against a Dean and put your life in danger. I’m not asking this of you lightly.
NoLoc - A few mysterious setbacks, coming right up, then!
NoLoc - ...This had better pay real well. You’re asking me to risk my entire career.
NoLoc - I’ve spent the last few hours putting together the details of the job.  Here's what we know for sure.

NoLoc - One, the tunnel in question is in the part of the factory accessible through a Ruined Golem Warehouse, in the old battlefield just beyond the front gate. I don’t know how the Wolfgang got a key to the place, but you’ll likely need your own.
NoLoc - Two, the Wolfgang Mercs have been hired to run security for the mine tunnel. There are at least 2 guys, plus one dog Golem with the new Power Coil model as backup patrolling down there.
NoLoc - Three, The mercs have also been hired to provide the explosives, although in order to get certain materials, they're taking out a series of loans from the Mercantile provost.
NoLoc - Four, The Engineering Branch said they've detected another splinter tunnel that goes into the part of the factory under the Mana lake, near the Troglodyte Warren down there.
NoLoc - So, I've put together five options we could pursue to delay the project. Here’s the plan...

NoLoc - Option 1, remove the Power Coil from the Dog Golem that’s guarding the tunnel, and replace it with this busted one. The mercs should have the dog on low power Scourge detection mode, so you should be able to sneak up and make the switch easily.

NoLoc - Do that, and they'll need to scramble to get a replacement.  If possible, avoid confronting the actual mercenaries there. Considering how important destroying the tunnel is...Conflict there could have lasting consequences on our reputation.

NoLoc - Option 2, sabotage the bombs that the mercs will use. They're likely to use three explosive packages, which they should be keeping at their camp. All you need to do is swap the red wires in the bombs with the blue ones, and they won't work as intended.

NoLoc - Option 3, if that side-tunnel that goes under the mana lake is actually connected to a trog burrow, throw this pot of Helen’s Troglodyte Pesticide down there. It’ll flush them towards the mine tunnel where they’ll sow confusion among the guards.

NoLoc - And lastly, we can try to call in a favor or two from the academy’s provosts. You might be able to convince the Mercantile provost to withhold the next few loans, which will force the Wolfgang to delay.
NoLoc - Finally, the Academic Provost is nominally the head of Sorobor while the Headmaster is gone. A letter from him to delay the demolition might buy us a little time.
NoLoc - Now, get this done swiftly and thoroughly, but try not to go overboard, alright?  We just need to buy some time, not shut the entire operation down.

NoLoc - I'd split this between you and Desy, but I’ve sent her to Berg to go request get an official response from the Headmaster. I don't know if I can trust the rest of my branch, so you're all I've got.
NoLoc - You trust me more than people who you’ve worked with for years?
NoLoc - I’m on it. I’ll be back when I’m done.
NoLoc - In general?  No.  For dealing with Victor?  Yes. I know that in no uncertain terms he has it out for you. You have no reason to go back to him.
NoLoc - I’m on it. I’ll be back when I’m done.
NoLoc - I know the Advanced Syntax.
NoLoc - Oh.  Impressive.  But you see the problem then, right?
NoLoc - I know the basics.
NoLoc - Uh huh.  Well, let me explain some advanced theory to you.
NoLoc - So, how’s the mission going? Do you have an update for me?
NoLoc - I'm not done just yet...
NoLoc - I’m done.
NoLoc - Can you run the plan by me again?
NoLoc - Are you sure?  You’re positive that we can’t make the outcome more certain?
NoLoc - I'm positive we're in the clear. Any more would be unsafe.
NoLoc - I'm not done just yet...
NoLoc - Alright, I’ll go over the plan with you again.  Listen up!
